acceptance: Red test first, with fake bridge seams: a chosen audit_fix with one prescription on a cited test file applies the patch, asks for one review seat of a family other than the auditor, runs the gates and returns Handled true.

A patch outside the cited files or the audit_fix bounds is refused before the review. A failed review or a red gate returns one escalation; a second failure returns a stop with the reason audit_fix_exhausted.
ChooseAuditFix counts only the lane findings of the fixability classifier; a hand-off finding never reaches the handler. Under ADR-0157 enforce, a patch on a fence path joins the held proposal.
workflow.retry_ladder.audit_fix.stage is a strict stage key (off, shadow, enforce; default shadow); at shadow the handler records what it does and changes no file.
docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md section 5 replaces the rule that the auditor seat never does the fix with the two-seat rule of ADR-0158.
fix: Implement core.RungHandler in a pure package auditfix. Handle sends the prescriptions to the live audit session, takes its patch, refuses a patch outside the cited files or the audit_fix bounds, asks for a fresh review seat of another family on the patch only, then asks for the handoff floor and the ship importer backstop. On a failed review or gate it returns one escalation (a raised build with the L6 digest), then a stop.
notes: Rank 6. PR #1173 is on main: go/internal/retryladder/audit_fix.go, go/internal/policy/workflow_retry_ladder_audit_fix.go and core.RungHandler come from it; this item creates only go/internal/auditfix/ and changes ChooseAuditFix to count only lane findings. The registration core.WithRungHandler and the audit session hook are fenced call sites (phases/audit), so wire-cost-aware-repair-call-sites wires them.
routed_reason: ADR-0158 plan section 6: no fence path to change; a fenced call site is a split
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator request on cycle 2035 ("balance to cost and output"). ADR-0158; plan docs/plans/cost-aware-repair-2026-10.md
summary: PR #1173 chooses audit_fix when every finding has a small prescription, but no handler runs it (core.RungHandler, core.WithRungHandler(retryladder.RungAuditFix, h)). In cycle 2035 the round 3 fix of a test helper cost tdd 4.6 and build 47.0 LLM minutes. The operator decided: the auditor fixes small prescribed findings in its loaded session, a different fresh seat reviews only that patch, the gates rerun, one escalation then stop.
title: The audit_fix rung handler: the auditor applies a small prescribed patch and a fresh seat reviews it (ADR-0158)
